acceptance.given: A complete current Consumer Manifest and the repository real-call surface are available; the surface includes VDD package-validation callers, Acceptance package-validation callers, and workflow-model-routing consumers.

oracle.expected: A repository-owned reconciliation produces both manifest-to-caller and caller-to-manifest results with no unmatched entries, and explicitly records VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing consumers as represented.
forbidden: Any in-scope VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing repository caller is absent from the Consumer Manifest.
A manifest entry has no corresponding current repository caller.
A one-way reconciliation, route-reachability-only check, or omitted-caller check is accepted as complete.
oracle.observable: The reconciliation result emitted by the Consumer Manifest validator, together with the declared manifest and scanned repository caller set.

acceptance.then: The complete current Consumer Manifest is bidirectionally reconciled against the repository real-call surface with every in-scope caller represented.
acceptance.when: The repository Toolchain reconciliation validates the frozen complete Consumer Manifest against its current caller scan.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the Consumer Manifest reconciliation selector with an otherwise valid manifest that omits one discovered VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing caller; require the bidirectional coverage check to reject the unmatched repository caller.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Extend the repository-owned Toolchain reconciliation so it scans the real VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing package-validation call surface and compares that set in both directions with the complete current Consumer Manifest, rejecting either caller omissions or manifest-only entries.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: The reconciliation is a non-authorizing Toolchain validation addition; it does not alter Phase service, runtime, or persisted workspace state.

slice_hint.state_transition: An unestablished reconciliation outcome becomes a deterministic complete bidirectional mapping between the current Consumer Manifest and all in-scope repository callers.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The reconciliation command reports zero caller-without-manifest and zero manifest-without-caller entries, including explicit VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing coverage; any unmatched entry exits nonzero.
